trigger: Raw organ-to-organ transfer had 0/8 stable-helpful edges and the read-only exact-gene and multiscale audits did not reveal a general seed-stable representation.
primary_question: Can an identifiable shared program path preserve independently validated organ specialization while learning reproducible per-sample coordinates across pooled-trunk seeds?

architecture.shared_path: input-derived 32-vector from an observed-gene mean hidden summary; decoded through the fixed training-expression basis
architecture.private_path: hard-dispatched K8 residual adapters; organ label is visible only to this path
architecture.fixed_program_decoder: 32 PCA components fitted before this experiment on GTEx training expression only, multiplied by the frozen training-gene scale
architecture.random_decoder: fixed 32-dimensional random orthonormal basis generated once with NumPy PCG64 seed 20260731 and multiplied by the same scale
architecture.identifiability: program axes and signs are fixed before fitting; coefficient order cannot rotate independently across seeds
architecture.score_scope: heads are fit and evaluated only on the 4634 frozen score genes; the trunk still receives the full expression vector
architecture.initialization_matching: all shared coefficient heads start identically within seed and all K8 private banks start identically within seed

training.mask_scope: 30 percent of frozen score genes per fitting draw

evaluation.performance_aggregation: equal organs, equal held-out donors within organ
evaluation.coefficient_aggregation: average samples within held-out donor before cross-seed comparison
evaluation.seed_policy: report all three fixed seeds; select none

success_gate.joint_requirement: utility and coefficient-alignment gates must both pass; neither alone advances the architecture

decision_rule.joint_pass: advance the aligned shared/private architecture to prospective study-disjoint confirmation and test whether stable coefficients predict safe sharing
decision_rule.utility_only: revise coefficient identifiability or supervision once; do not claim a stable biological representation
decision_rule.alignment_only: do not advance an architecture that is reproducible but loses predictive utility
decision_rule.joint_fail: pivot Stage 2 beyond organ-only representation and preregister a broader attribute/program hypothesis

claim_boundary: This is donor-disjoint GTEx development evidence. It can test whether fixed program coordinates improve seed alignment without erasing organ utility; it cannot establish biological mechanism, universality across independent studies, or downstream spaceflight or disease benefit.
